originalFullP2Obligations.text: Retain genuine verified boundary; native membership and complete app suffix; no old actor re-verification on normal warm path.
Prefer existing retained native MST and CID ecosystem; justify any alternate strategy against actual proof needs.
Account root/revision, advertised head, verified app head and interpreted frontier remain distinct.
Bound concurrency and any key cache; canonical-key and low-S rules unchanged.
Gaps, forks, rollback, old mutations, duplicate positions/requests/nonces/descriptors and canonical/forged input failures.
Source-only, key-only, PLC-tip-only and unrelated-app changes remain observable without old actor/fold work.
Stale/mixed-root, missing/evicted/pruned blocks, partial diffs and disconnected/corrupt restore recovery.
Concurrent appends and stale in-flight reads cannot lower accepted or fully checked unpublished floors.
Cold/warm/resumed state, source, authority, identities, outcomes and frontiers equal full native replay.
Full implementation code/tests, dated results, raw attributable evidence, honest limits and unrun cases.
Unsettled design decisions reviewed before code; exact-head atseq-reviewer architecture/security/simplification review before gitseq merge and push.
No arbitrary latency target and no spike compatibility goal; characterize circumstances and explicit options.
